name: 91702 · Azusa, CA
findings: ZIP 91702 (Azusa) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91702 (Azusa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91702 (Azusa) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
